nodes.label: i
nodes.title: The Question Paper will have 75 questions.

nodes.label: ii
nodes.title: All questions will be based on Subject-Specific Knowledge.

nodes.label: I
nodes.title: Social concepts:
nodes.body: Family, marriage, neighborhood, community, organization, culture, caste, clan, values, culture, traditions, practices, norms, lifestyle, health, socialization, needs.

nodes.label: II
nodes.title: Economic concepts:
nodes.body: Economy, market, production, distribution, demand, supply, labor, income, expenditure, globalization, privatization, liberalization, industrialization.

nodes.label: III
nodes.title: Political concepts:
nodes.body: Politics, democracy, decentralization, panchayat, legislature, executive, judiciary, human rights, social justice, freedom, liberty, fundamental rights & duties.

nodes.label: IV
nodes.title: Psychological concepts:
nodes.body: Individual, self, behavior, mental functions, attitude, emotions, beliefs, self-esteem,intelligence.

nodes.label: V
nodes.title: Environmental concepts:
nodes.body: Environment, atmosphere, pollution-air, water, sound; natural resources - air, water, soil, forest; disaster

nodes.label: VI
nodes.title: Legal concepts:
nodes.body: Constitution, law, petition, litigation, First-hand information report (FIR),

nodes.label: VII
nodes.title: Social reform, Social movement, Social work:
nodes.body: Concepts: Social reform, social movement, revolution, Satyagraha, non-violence, truth, justice, peace, social work, social development; Bhakti movement – Guru Nanak, Kabir, Basaveshwar Social reformers – Raja Ram Mohan Roy, Swami Vivekananda, Dhondo Singh Karve Freedom movement – Gandhi, Subhash Chandra Bose Dalit & Social movement – Ambedkar, Medha Patkar, Anna Hazare, Aruna Roy Non-government organizations, Corporate.

nodes.label: IX
nodes.title: Sustainable technologies:
nodes.body: Forms of sustainable technologies: solar, wind, bio-gas, bio-mass, bio-diesel; Pollution controlthrough technologies.
